Name: (CP) Shane Sprite Edit
Author: samsomn
Description:
[size=4]HEY YOU! Yeah, you! Are [i]you [/i]a Shane fan? Well, I am too! So, I made some sprite edits for my Shaney Waney as he deserves better!!!!!![/size]

      Being a fan of Shane over the years, I've noticed something off about his sprite.. He doesn't have the same beautiful green eyes as his portrait does!! Not to mention his SLEEP OUTFIT?? Why on earth is that man wearing his stinky Joja jacket to bed! And the lack of socks... I made this lovely sprite edit to fix these issues!
     I originally made this mod back in 2021, but never uploaded it and it has since been lost to time.. But I have YEARNED to have it back, so I remade it! I hope you enjoy this sprite edit as much as I do :)

[size=4][b]CONFUSED ON HOW TO USE THIS BEAUTIFUL MOD?[/b][/size]
[size=4]Just follow these three simple steps![/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]STEP ONE: Download and install Content Patcher ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] )[/color]
STEP TWO: Download and install this mod!
STEP THREE: Enjoy his new and improved look!




PS!!! Check out my other mod:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51025](FS) Goldenfields Closet at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url] !!!!! (It was used in the fourth image for my farmer!)
